messages:
Maya R.: Hi team — monitor shipped to SF-office but the USB-C cable in the box is frayed and doesn't charge the laptop. Also getting 'certificate not trusted' when joining corp-wifi via the SSO page. Order RDW-7992. Any quick fixes?
Sam (buddy): Welcome Maya! :wave: For cable ping @Will - Facilities, for certs @Pri (IT). Reception sometimes swaps cables.
Will - Facilities: Hey Maya, can you confirm the cable label (USB-C 100W) and DM a photo of the damage? If it's damaged we'll drop a replacement. We keep loaner cables at reception if you need one now.
Maya R.: Cable says "Redwood USB-C 100W". Photo DM'd. Reception said "no swap".
Pri (IT): For the cert, what's the exact popup text? If it's "NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID" try re-enroll at https://internal.it/redwood/enroll and run:
```
sudo /usr/local/bin/rw-wifi enroll
```
If helper errors, paste output and I'll create a ticket.
Maya R.: Popup: "Certificate chain validation failed". Ran helper -> "keychain access denied". I'm on macOS 13.4.
Pri (IT): Filed IT-2026-4720. Quick workaround: open Keychain Access -> unlock login keychain -> retry. If remote session helps I can connect.
Will - Facilities: Replacement cable OR-2026-333 sent to reception, ETA 2 hours. Loaner available now if you want it.
ops-bot: Ticket IT-2026-4720 status -> Open.
Maya R.: Thanks all 30 I'll grab the loaner and join the remote session if needed. Appreciate the help!
